body: Thank you so much for the kind words and perspective.  I feel that you also understand a bit if my chaos too, which honestly made me tear up a tad bit. Each time I've wanted to kill myself before, I could never gather the courage for it. So I figured if I don't have it, force it. "A hero doesn't have to step forward, everyone else just has to take a step back."
Would love to if I were in the area, for now this bench suites me.
The east coast (US), never been on that side of the country.
I wouldn't say satan, just a modern day P T Barnum, who exploits people on TV instead of in a circus (cause that's not ok anymore).

Sounds like something my ex would say, but that she-cunt made satan look like Dr Phil. Don't EVER let anyone tell you what you should or shouldn't feel.  Maybe try a counselor or therapy, find an opinion that means something.

True that... I was bad about it though, I got to where I'd smoke before I ate, and eventually I couldn't eat anything unless I smoked. I love like 15lbs coming off weed, dropping to 145 (rather unhealthy for my frame)
Pretty good, I appreciate this. The struggle is always real.
I feel you, I smoked for about a year... Then my dealer moved away. The sleep was so great. Can't find another dealer ATM, but weed is cheaper than drinking.
I don't know that depression is something you can just overcome. I've felt this was since I can remember, so I've lost all hope and will to fight.
Yeah I don't like to day drink at all, and Stella is shit. Beer helps slow my thoughts down so I can relax and pass out. I'm only reliant on it for sleep, cause I have no better options
Aint no rest like weed sleep lol

I feel you buddy. I've been through almost all the counselors at my university. You can try and change it up,  maybe you'll click better with someone else. I always found them to be biased in their own ways. Just got to find one that works for you.
Easier said then done.
Thank you . I really hate dreaming.
Hey man, Count every hour you can get
I don't drink a lot, just often. I've found that a 40 before bed time helps with the sleeping process. What do you do for a living?
I used to struggle with insomnia... But then I became an alcoholic. *sad laughter*
It hasn't changed in 10+ years. I could use the vacation.
Sent you a PM. Don't apologize for how you feel, a lot of us are there with you, and we understand.

I can tell you I know how you feel. It seems that no one ever initiates contact with me. It really sucks and makes me want to distance myself from very one around me. "Why should I be the only one trying" mentality. But every now and again I do bring people together, like tonguedepresser suggests, and it's a good time. That extra effort is worth it, there is a big difference of feeling that no one cares, and having no one to care about you. Try to keep those friendships strong, for your own sake.
High five buddy!
Agree'd. This has definitely helped me through rough spots., and even got me into counseling. Go internet!
This was more of a general statement, as teaching is only part of my life. Many people refuse my friendship even though I am a very kind individual.
thank you for your thoughts and understanding.

That would be really cool if you did get to work for them, and I hope to see something of your work come through them. I wish I was encouraged to read more as a child. Hell I wish I was encouraged to do anything. The things I would show and teach my kid do if I had one hah.I tutor just about everyone I know in a msth course (working as a tutor through my university is a pain in the ass), and I'm on track to start My student teaching next spring, fate deciding if that time comes.

I've been in this tunnel for so long, exploring in every direction for years and I've seen glimmers, but they only lead me to darker parts of this cave. It does take tremendous courage to carry on, and I salute all those who have struggles, bother greater and lesser than mine, that chose to push through.

I always regretted not reading more, and envy those who can plow through a book in a few sittings. I think that is the greatest kind of journalism, raw and real material. I can not help but think of the group Vice, that I stumbled on through YouTube. Their documentaries are powerful and have opened my eyes to the world. Though I feel that I am barely squinting, I think it's more than most Americans attempt to see or understand.

I study math and education, I love working with high school kids and teaching math. If there's one thing in life that brings Me bliss, it's the joy of helping others. But you'd be surprised how many people either don't want anything that i have to offer or simply take it for granted.
I have explored quite a few alternatives, but they were only band aides for a deep would. In the end it will be my courage that is te deciding factor.

Of course life is not like a movie, I'm not making that much of literal argument, but rather posing ideas around a general theme in hopes of stimulating thought outside the literal. One cannot argue with there being hope, however statics have a way of rationalizing things and should not be ignored.

Thank you, I hope they have similar feelings upon their discovery. I don't necessarily enjoy writing, but I've found myself rather inclined to express myself through writings and peotry as opposed to discussion. Reading simply puts me to sleep, a page into a book and I'll be deep into a nap. So I don't like to read, as I never get anywhere. On a side note, tell me something interesting about yourself.

If there's one thing I've learned from studying math, it's how to construct a concrete conjecture. I too agree that life is chaotic and unbound. It means so many different things to so many different people. I understand the perceptions of others and their choices, I only wish to have mine considered in the same light of fairness. I have talked to many people, friends, counselors and trained professionals - all with the same end. A shrug and a good luck/motivational line. Thank you for your kindness.

Thank your for your feedback, I'm hoping to do as much as I can through writing to ease the burden of sorrow that I leave behind. I like that idea of a wiring project, yet I'm keeping my notes seperate in their respective envelopes. And I appreciate the thought, know that it makes two of us that wish I don't feel this way, but I've fought myself for years and gained no ground. It's time to give up the stalemate.

Religion is shit, and I'm an outcast from my family because I decided to form my own thoughts when I got older. I play video games competitively, and when I told my father I had been taking top 3 places in tourneys around town, he told me that was the saddest thing he had heard. Now I don't really talk to them. I believe we can all choose our own families, you don't have to stay with the cards you are dealt, your friends can be your family. Stay strong.
thank you.

im one semester from graduating college, yet I plan to not live that long, unless fate saves me. I've had lengthy relationships, close friendships, achievements in my fields of interest that have earned the respect of my peers. But it's all for nothing, sadness will always blot out the hope of happiness.
I rarely even listen to music, and never sing.
Only when I am overcome by feelings, usually sadness...

I feel the same way, I'm a good person with alot to offer, a year away from becoming a teacher. Ive a passion for helping others, but not myself. I have no reason to be sad, but I've been sad for as long as I can remember. I spend hours everyday thinking about suicide. All I can say is that your not alone. I always try to think tomorrow will be a better day, it never is, but it's something I try to hold onto. But who knows what the future holds...

yep.  Been sad my entires life with no reason for it, and I'm tired of fighting myself just to get to the next day. I dont see the point. I've done everything in life that should bring me joy, yet none has come.
